title: log3gpp: De-duplicate code for building a packet record.
description:
Collect common code from log3gpp_read and log3gpp_seek_read into a new worker
function, build_packet_record.

The only functional difference should be that rec->rec_header.packet_header.len
and rec->rec_header.packet_header.caplen will now be set in log3gpp_seek_read
too, whereas before they were only set in log3gpp_read.
